title: Transfer response and selected-control regret under bounded diagonal model error
statement: Within the original real finite-range dephased tracial transport class,a diagonal perturbation with sup_i sum_(X contains i)||Delta H_X||<=epsilon gives sup_V|D_actual-D_nominal|<=8t^2 epsilon/d^2. A nominal data-selected global regret certificate r therefore transfers as regret_actual<=r+16t^2 epsilon/d^2.

requires: Same hopping,uniform physical dephasing,trace,translation and bounded finite-range structure
Only real diagonal Hamiltonian error,uniform incident norm bound over the design-control domain
Inherited thermodynamic scalar and nominal regret certificate under their original hypotheses
provides: Population-annihilating perturbation has normalized relative norm<=4epsilon/d uniformly in regularizer and ring size
Accretive resolvent identity plus actual current bound t^2/(2d) gives |delta kappa|<=2t^2 epsilon/d^2
Use d_min for uncertain dephasing;source Ramsey contrast at time1/2 needs an additional bias reservation<=2epsilon
assumptions: This does not extend the same relative bound to unspecified off-diagonal or nonunital/memory-noise errors
Actual sensing observation-law bias must also hold;an already spent1e-4 bias budget cannot be reused
A severe sufficient incident-error tolerance is not a necessary hardware limit or demonstrated calibration
costs: Acquire the structural/error bound,physical noise/hopping and bias budget;none supplied by a source hash
Ordinary methods may use the same perturbation bound and observations
contract.units: Uniform response difference and selected-control regret
contract.obstruction: No arbitrary model-robust physical controller or full-class decision-complexity theorem.
